title: Spicy Italian Sausage and Pepperoni Pizza Dip
description: A cheesy, spicy dip perfect for game day or parties, served with garlic bread, Tostitos, or club crackers.
steps: Cook Italian sausage and onion with your seasoning blend.
Add that to a crock pot with the rest of your ingredients.
Cook on high for 1–2 hours, stirring every 15 minutes or so.
notes:
Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1APDqr4sFi/

Nutrition: Serving 1/8 of dip · Calories 250 kcal · Fat 20 g · Saturated fat 10 g · Unsaturated fat 10 g · Trans fat 0 g · Cholesterol 70 mg · Sodium 700 mg · Carbs 8 g · Fiber 1 g · Sugar 3 g · Protein 12 g

healthy: Onion and pepperoncinis add a little vegetable.
not_healthy: Italian sausage and pepperoni are processed meats high in saturated fat and sodium.
Cream cheese, mozzarella and cheddar add more saturated fat.
Usually served with chips or bread.
